name: Internal Degree Product
description: Defines the required subgraph using the arithmetic product of the degrees of its vertices within the induced subgraph. By requiring the product of the three internal degrees to be exactly 8, it forces all three degrees to be 2 (since the maximum internal degree in a trio is 2). This completely hides the "triangle" or "clique" structure behind a numeric property, defeating models that rely on logical implications or graph terminology to identify the target structure.
